// Not a source file: the .ts.txt suffix keeps it out of `eslint .` and out of tsc.
// boundary.spec.ts copies it to a .ts path inside apps/agent-op and expects that lint
// run to fail, so the no-restricted-imports rule cannot go inert unnoticed (T-OP-03).
import { evaluateRules } from '@platform/security/rules';
import { VertexAI } from '@google-cloud/vertexai';

export function decide(): unknown {
  return evaluateRules(new VertexAI({ project: 'p' }));
}
